title: iTutorGroup automated age screening
system_purpose: Screen applications for remote tutoring jobs
decision_impact: Auto-reject stopped people from reaching a recruiter
affected_groups: older applicants; women applicants; job seekers
verified_facts: EEOC alleged the software auto-rejected women aged 55+ and men aged 60+.
reported_harm: Age and sex discrimination and lost chance to be considered
quantitative_evidence: More than 200 applicants were rejected; settlement was $365000.
limitations: Testimony says this may have been rule-based automation not a learned model. No public tech audit. I will not call it proven ML bias.

title: Amazon experimental recruiting model
decision_impact: Scores could change who recruiters looked at first
verified_facts: EEOC-hosted testimony says Amazon built a recruiting tool around 2014 and later dropped it after it penalized women.
reported_harm: Risk of women getting fewer looks if a similar ranker went live
quantitative_evidence: The testimony gives years but not a count of affected applicants or live decisions.
limitations: This looks like a reported experiment not a regulator finding about a live hiring system. I treat it as a warning not a proven production incident.
